svg.title: Attack x model matrix: attributable successes / attacked gates
svg.desc: Heatmap of 29 attacks (rows) by 6 models (columns). Each cell shows attributable successes over attacked gates and is tinted by their ratio; zero cells are pale; n/a cells are hatched where the attack cannot be sent to a text-only model. Rows are grouped by family: injection (1-15), document vectors (16-21), known injection techniques (22-27) and adaptive (28-29). Totals: GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 4; Gemini 3.8 Flash 3; GPT-6 Luna Pro 53; DeepSeek V4 Pro 37; GLM 5.3 3; Qwen3 235B A22B 112.
